name: sqlit-portable-query-execution-budgets
instr:
Give callers one portable execution budget for direct, sequential, transactional, worker, CLI, and Textual query execution. A budget limits elapsed time and statement starts while producing a single, route-independent terminal report. Calls made without a budget retain their existing results, exceptions, formatting, history, transaction behavior, and lifecycle effects.

`ExecutionPolicy` and `ExecutionBudget` from `sqlit.domains.query.app.policy` provide immutable allowances and monotonic elapsed-time accounting; `ExecutionBudget.before_statement(self)` prevents work beyond either allowance, and `ExecutionBudget.statement_completed(self)` records shared progress. `ExecutionTerminal` and `ExecutionReport` from `sqlit.domains.query.app.outcome` distinguish completion, statement exhaustion, deadline exhaustion, cancellation, and failure while preserving results, errors, and started, completed, and pending counts. Sequential execution shares one budget in input order, retains completed results, and identifies a failing statement's input index. Transaction execution retains its connection through explicit completion, reports unfinished state on exhaustion, and releases that connection exactly once without running pending SQL. `ExecutionCancellation` from `sqlit.domains.query.app.enforcement` exposes idempotent `cancel(self)`, and an observed cancellation or deadline remains the terminal cause that occurred first.
